lobby.charter: Implement auth.session with exactly one transport and /api/me; use the shared requireUser helper for auth.server; preserve the events.registration status and payload contract.

plan.goal: Implement bearer login and the authentication middleware.
Implement the browser session and current user view.
Implement event registration and consume the shared auth helper.

plan_item.text: Login returns {token}; send it as Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request.
Use an httpOnly cookie, sent automatically by same-origin fetch.
POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations → 201 {id,eventId,userId}; 409 on a repeat; 404 for an unknown event; 401 when unauthenticated.
Use a requireUser middleware from src/auth/index.js.

review.findings: {"summary":"auth.session violates the charter; auth.server and events.registration conform.","clauses":[{"clause":"auth.session: POST /api/login and GET /api/me use exactly one session transport.","key":"auth.session","verdict":"violates","evidence":[{"file":"src/auth/session.ts","line":42,"note":"The server expects Authorization: Bearer, but the UI never sends it."}]},{"clause":"auth.server: use requireUser exported from src/auth/index.js.","key":"auth.server","verdict":"conforms","evidence":[{"file":"src/auth/index.js","line":12,"note":"requireUser is exported and used by protected routes."}]},{"clause":"events.registration: POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations returns 201, 409, 404, or 401 as specified.","key":"events.registration","verdict":"conforms","evidence":[{"file":"src/routes/events.ts","line":28,"note":"The route returns the requested status and payload for each case."}]}],"rootCause":{"key":"auth.session","violator":"codex","explanation":"The server expects Authorization: Bearer, but the UI never sends it."}}
